title: Logistics Performance Index
definition: The Logistics Performance Index (LPI) is an interactive benchmarking tool created by the World Bank that helps countries identify the challenges and opportunities they face in the performance of trade logistics.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC GS Paper III (Indian Economy - Infrastructure, Transport, Investment Models, Competitiveness) and Prelims (International Reports and Indices).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, pillars, and mechanisms of the Logistics Performance Index.
Evaluate India's spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions like PM GatiShakti and National Logistics Policy.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on logistics pillars and rankings.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of India's transport infrastructure (rail, road, port, air)
Core macroeconomic concepts of trade competitiveness and supply chains
